KarteaHardwareService

class KarteaHardwareService(calibration_service=None)[source]

Bases: object

Hardware service (MVCS) of KarTEA.

Covers screen, camera, calibration and MediaPipe. Kept apart from PlayerKarteaConfigService, which handles only the player configuration. It hands ready values to the game components (CameraConfig, PoseTrackingConfig, calibration points), so that Camera and PoseTracking do not depend on services.

Parameters:
calibration_serviceCalibrationService | None, optional

T-TEA service with the calibration and hardware data. Created if None. Kept private.
